experience_thesis: You do not look at the brand plate on a page — you land inside it, and the lit root system runs off the bottom of the frame and into the content, so everything the farm publishes grows out of the same image.

brand.promise: Built on purpose. Rooted in strength. Living soil inside engineered hardware, on the Lake Erie plain, all year round.
anti_tone: generic premium dark-and-gold with no imagery behind it
brand.trust_posture: Every crop shown is one the owner confirmed growing; anything unconfirmed is absent rather than approximated. The register is dated and its standings are set by hand, never derived.
brand.audience_sophistication: Local buyers who want to know where their food came from, and chefs who need to know what is cuttable this week.

composition.layout_model: A full-viewport plate as the front door, with every subsequent band rising over it on the plate's own near-black ground.
composition.grid: Single measured column for reading; a five-across row for the pillars that stacks to two and then one. Never a card grid.
composition.rhythm: One enormous held image, then a long exhale, then dense tabular work, then another exhale. No two adjacent bands share a vertical padding value.
focal_path: The emblem and its lit roots
The wordmark and the founding year
Where it grows — bench or ground
composition.dominant_mass: The plate. Nothing else on the site competes with it, and nothing tries to.
composition.negative_space: Generous and dark. The ground between bands is the same near-black as the plate's bottom edge, so the page reads as one continuous field.

intensity_map.purpose: The signature — the whole front door
Carry the plate's ornament language into the page
The one live fact worth a large voice
Answer a question and get out of the way

color.contrast_strategy: Every value is sampled from the plate rather than chosen. The sampled mid-tones landed near 4.0:1 on the base and were lifted until they cleared 4.5:1; src/lib/palette.test.ts reads the stylesheet and holds that line. Stone is deliberately kept under the text threshold so it can only ever be a hairline.
color.glow_policy: Glow is the root light. It is reserved for focus rings and the single brightest ornament, never applied as a surface treatment and never behind running text.

typography.display_voice: Inscribed Roman capitals, matching the plate's own bevelled wordmark so the logo reads as part of the page rather than pasted onto it.
typography.body_voice: A serif with enough weight to hold its own on a near-black ground, where a lighter face disappears.
typography.technical_voice: The same inscribed capitals at small size with wide tracking — the plate's own voice for labels, standings and dates.
typography.scale: Violent. Display runs to 7xl against 11px tracked capitals; there is no comfortable middle, because the plate has none.
typography.line_length: 58–70 characters for prose. The register is tabular and ignores measure.
typography.variable_font_strategy: Two families only, self-hosted, subset, weights trimmed to what is used.

spacing_and_shape.section_rhythm: Four named bands with deliberately unequal padding. Reaching for a raw py-* on a section is the wrong move.
spacing_and_shape.border_language: Hairlines only, in the plate's gold, at three weights. No boxes, no panels, no cards, no rounded corners.

material.surface_language: Forged metal and wet stone, photographed once and then never imitated in CSS. The page itself is flat near-black; all material lives in the plate.
material.light: The plate's own: a low sun on the water and the root system lit from within. The page adds one warm radial wash beneath the emblem and nothing else.
material.depth: One layer only. The hero holds its place while content rises over it, which is layout rather than a parallax effect.
material.texture: None applied. The photograph carries all of it.
material.transparency_policy: A single gradient veil dissolving the roots into the page. No glass, no backdrop blur anywhere.
material.shadow_policy: No shadows, on anything, in any state.

imagery.photography: The owner's brand plate is the only image on the site, cut into a wide crop for landscape and a portrait crop centred on the emblem for phones. No stock, no generated photographs, and nothing depicting a room that does not exist yet.
imagery.illustration: Line glyphs redrawn from the plate's own pillar marks — mountains, roots, lighthouse, waves, leaves — plus a compass rose and a diamond-broken rule. Stroke only, one weight, the plate's gold.
imagery.icons: The pillar glyphs and nothing else. Every one is paired with its title as real text.
imagery.maps: A text address and one link out. No embedded map on the front page, and no map-shaped placeholder ever.
imagery.data_visualization: The register is a real table, because the reader's job is to look up a row. No timelines, no bars, no Gantt-shaped rows.
imagery.asset_provenance_rule: The plate is the owner's own artwork. Every derived crop is generated from it in-repo and committed; nothing is redrawn, approximated or sourced elsewhere.

purpose: hold the plate while the page rises over it

grammar.link: colour shifts toward the root light

motion.scroll_policy: Standard scrolling. No scroll-driven animation, no parallax, no reveal-on-scroll. Everything is in the document at first paint.
motion.pointer_policy: Nothing tilts, follows or lights up under the cursor.
motion.reduced_motion: The page is very nearly identical with the preference set, because there is almost nothing to reduce. The two colour transitions are collapsed.

responsive.mobile_composition: The plate's own arrangement: the scene as a block at its natural aspect, the wordmark and founding year beneath it on the dark ground. The masthead stacks rather than shrinking its tracking.
responsive.desktop_expansion: The scene fills the viewport and turns sticky, the lockup sits low in it, and the content rises over it. Not the mobile layout stretched.
content_extremes: nothing cutting at all — the state at launch
a crop name longer than its column
responsive.zoom_and_reflow: The register reflows before it scrolls. No horizontal page scroll at 320px or at 200% zoom.

render.activation_reason: The plate does all the work a canvas or a 3D scene would be reached for, at a fraction of the cost and with none of the fallback burden. Reaching past T1 here would add risk and subtract nothing.

budgets.javascript: Under 150KB gzipped first load; no client JavaScript belonging to any content route
budgets.hero: Under 100KB for the LCP image, in AVIF with a WebP fallback
budgets.lcp: Under 2.5s on a throttled Pixel 5 over Slow 4G
budgets.cls: Under 0.1 — every image carries explicit dimensions

render.fallback: With CSS disabled the page is a readable document: a described photograph, a heading, a table and an address.

accessibility.contrast: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum on every run of text, verified in a real browser rather than asserted — including colours Tailwind emits as oklab, which an earlier version of the checker misread as near-black.
accessibility.semantic_equivalent: The plate carries a full text description. The register is a real table with a caption and scoped headers. Standings are stated in words as well as in colour, so nothing depends on the accent alone.
accessibility.motion_control: Barely applicable by design; the reduced-motion branch collapses what little exists.
accessibility.focus_and_input: A two-pixel glow outline with offset, never removed, visible on both the plate and the dark ground. Full keyboard operation.
accessibility.transparency_fallback: The veil is a gradient over an opaque ground; with it removed the type still sits on near-black.

anti_patterns: the plate used as a boxed image inside a page instead of being the page
gradient or chrome fill on live text — the wordmark is the only bevelled type and it is a photograph
cards, panels, boxes, rounded corners, or borders enclosing on four sides
glass, backdrop blur, or drop shadow of any kind
glow used as a surface treatment rather than as the root light
a second decorative image competing with the plate
stock or generated photography of the farm
dashed placeholder rectangles or 'coming soon' boxes
timeline, Gantt or progress-bar treatments of non-quantities
rendered copy that names a file, framework or variable
publishing any crop the owner has not confirmed growing
cover-cropping the plate so hard that the emblem stops being recognisable

reference_sources.source: The owner's Lake Erie IronRoots brand plate
take: the entire palette, sampled rather than chosen
the emblem, the wordmark and the five pillar glyphs
the diamond-broken rule and the compass rose
inscribed Roman capitals with wide tracking
storm, wet stone, low sun, and light coming from the roots
avoid: imitating the bevelled metal in CSS
redrawing the emblem rather than using it
letting the baked type in the plate appear twice on one screen
treating the plate as decoration behind a conventional layout
